data.key: Pattern Breaker ~ Disable Weapon or Armor
data.name: Disable Weapon or Armor
data.description: You have learned to temporarily suppress the magical qualities of a weapon or armor with a touch.  As a melee touch attack that does not provoke attacks of opportunity, you can target one magical weapon or armor on a creature.  If the attack is successful, you make a manifester level check against a DC of 11 + the manifester level of the item.  If the manifester level check is successful, all magical or psionic qualities of the item are suppressed for %1 rounds.  There is no limit to the number of items you can affect, although you can only affect one per use.|DisableWeaponOrArmorDuration
